name: agent-workflows
description: Custom agent skills for debugging, QA loops, PR review workflows, shipping, log inspection, and Claude/Codex collaboration.

interface.longDescription: Workflow skills for hypothesis-driven debugging, paired QA loops, PR review comment handling, PR shipping, and Claude/Codex collaboration.
defaultPrompt: Use debug-mode to investigate this bug
Use check-logs to inspect an existing herdr/turbo dev TUI
Use goal-loop to keep improving one thing end to end with Claude and Codex
Use review-pr-comments to handle this PR feedback
Use agents-pair to collaborate with Claude through the Claude Code CLI
Use art-director to run a design-exploration loop where you direct and a Codex pane generates mockups
Use herdr-pair to pair with the other agent
Use delegate to orchestrate work across Opus, Sonnet, and Codex
